blocks.text: The docstring explains this is B6 piece 6 — a straight lift from server.py with no logic changes. Imports pull in the agent modules (backlink_detector, note_clusterer), eo sub-modules (graph_edges, node_summaries, note_candidates, panel_content, chat_workspace), and eo.knowledge_graph's node primitives.
blocks.title: Module docstring and imports

blocks.text: Three routes: GET lists edges filtered by workspace_id, POST creates one edge with created_by='user' (distinguishing manual from agent-created edges), DELETE removes one by edge_id. ValueError from create_edge becomes a 400; FileNotFoundError from delete_edge becomes a 404.
blocks.title: Manual edge CRUD

blocks.anchor: def get_topics_graph(ws_id: str, owner_id: str = Depends(require_auth)):
blocks.text: Verifies workspace ownership, then reads the secondary_data document. Projects its topics dict into the same {nodes, edges} shape KnowledgeGraphView.jsx already consumes from the nodes endpoint. Builds synthetic parent_of edges from topic.parent fields (skipping dangling parents) and appends the existing connections list as-is. Entirely read-only.
blocks.title: Topics/graph projection

blocks.anchor: def delete_workspace_node(ws_id: str, node_id: str, owner_id: str = Depends(require_auth)):
blocks.text: Verifies workspace ownership, then collects same_source siblings by scanning edges whose relation is 'same_source' and whose to_node_id matches the target. Deletes every node in the batch, plus its edges and any cluster candidates that referenced it. After the per-node loop, calls cleanup_for_removed_source for the secondary-data topic tree and invalidate_for_nodes to clear only the panels built from these nodes.
blocks.title: Cascading node delete

blocks.text: Three routes for the propose/accept/reject workflow used by the silent note-taker agent. Accept returns the new node_id; reject deletes the candidate by candidate_id (not by list position, fixing a multi-user race bug noted in the comment at line 299).
blocks.title: Note candidate review

blocks.anchor: def detect_backlinks_endpoint(ws_id: str, owner_id: str = Depends(require_auth)):
blocks.text: detect_backlinks_endpoint triggers an on-demand rescan via agents/backlink_detector.py and returns the count of edges created. propose_clusters_endpoint similarly triggers agents/note_clusterer.py. Both share the same ownership-check guard. The three cluster-candidate routes (list, accept, reject) mirror the note-candidate shape exactly.
blocks.title: Backlink detection and auto-clustering

gotchas: delete_workspace_node deletes the full same_source batch, not just the node_id passed in — the sibling walk uses graph_edges.edges_for_node with relation == 'same_source'
get_topics_graph is read-only: it re-projects the secondary_data document every call, never writing to it
get_node_summaries has no POST counterpart by design; only agents write summaries
Panel invalidation is scoped to the deleted batch; unrelated manually-pasted panels are preserved
how_it_works: Each function is a FastAPI route handler decorated with @router.get/post/patch/delete; the router is an APIRouter that server.py includes
Authentication is enforced via require_auth (Depends); most routes pass workspace ownership through chat_workspace.get_workspace before proceeding
Graph reads delegate to eo/graph_edges.py, eo/node_summaries.py, eo/knowledge_graph.py, and eo/secondary_data.py

delete_workspace_node cascades: collects same_source siblings, deletes each node and its edges, prunes cluster candidates, cleans secondary-data topic entries, and invalidates only the affected saved panels
Backlink and cluster operations delegate to agents/backlink_detector.py and agents/note_clusterer.py
outputs: JSON: edge lists, node lists, topics/graph shape {nodes, edges}, candidate lists, operation status dicts
purpose: Exposes the graph and notes layer of the backend as HTTP routes. It covers manual edge management, the topics/graph read projection, node rename and cascading delete, silent note-taking candidate review, backlink detection, and cluster propose/accept/reject. This file is a pure move out of api/server.py with no behaviour changes.
side_effects: Writes to graph-edge store (create_edge, delete_edge)
Writes to knowledge-graph node store (rename_node, delete_node)
Writes to cluster-candidate store (reject_candidate on cascade)
Calls cleanup_for_removed_source (secondary-data writes)
Calls panel_content.invalidate_for_nodes (panel-cache writes)
Calls detect_backlinks and propose_clusters (agent calls that may write edges/candidates)
summary: FastAPI router for knowledge-graph edges, node CRUD, topic-graph projection, note candidates, and auto-clustering.

symbols.details: Finds all sibling nodes that share the same ingestion batch (same_source edges pointing at this node). Deletes every node in the batch one by one, and for each: removes all its edges (swallowing FileNotFoundError for already-gone edges), and rejects any cluster candidate that referenced it. After the loop, calls cleanup_for_removed_source to remove topic-tree entries derived from these nodes, and invalidate_for_nodes to clear only the panels that were built from this batch.
